observations: Two retail boxes for QASA QDL-300 Dry Irons are shown.
The boxes appear to be sealed in thin plastic wrap.
The brand 'QASA' and model 'QDL-300' are printed on the front of the boxes.
Text on the box indicates '300W Energy Saving' and 'Teflon Coated Soleplate'.
A watermark 'ABIOLAONIMACHINE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is visible across the image.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly printed on the boxes in photo 0.
Requires a photo of the rating plate on the actual iron to confirm wattage.
Requires a photo of the underside of the iron.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, cheaper item.
risks.proof: A photo of the iron outside of the box.

risks.risk: The iron may be used or have a damaged soleplate despite the box appearance.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the soleplate.

risks.risk: The heating element may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the indicator light turning on and the iron heating up.

proof_requests: Photo of the iron outside the box showing the soleplate.
Photo of the rating plate on the iron itself.
Video of the iron plugged in and heating up.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging, allowing for a baseline price at the worst-case condition.
